### FS Workspace (Tool)
Backend for the FS_Write / FS_Read / FS_List tools in the dev-team workflows. A single Code node does sandboxed file ops (write/read/list) directly against workspace/<session>/ in the repo -- no server involved.

**Requires** the n8n process to run with NODE_FUNCTION_ALLOW_BUILTIN=fs,path,child_process so Code nodes may use Node builtins.
